data.name: OrderedInsertionDescription
data.value: The browser can carry insertion context from the rule table, but ordered creation is not submitted yet. The REST shape, signed intent operation, stale-order precondition, and daemon/UFW insertion semantics require design approval. The existing signed add endpoint continues to mean append-only.

data.value: Ordered insertion is not yet authorized or submitted.

data.value: Reorder changes are staged in this browser. UFW has not changed, no ordering intent has been signed, and real add/delete mutations stay disabled until you discard or confirm the preview.

data.name: LatestRefreshFailed
